applicabilityBasis.summary: bIB01 is a tracker certificate (a security) referencing the BlackRock iShares $ Treasury Bond 0-1yr UCITS ETF, issued by Backed Assets (JE) Limited (Jersey). GENIUS Act §2(22)(B) (12 U.S.C. §5901(22)(B)) excludes from the payment-stablecoin definition any asset that meets the definition of a security under federal securities laws. Additionally, Backed does not offer or sell to US persons.

genius.licensingRegulator: Swiss DLT Act registered uncertificated securities framework
genius.notes: bIB01 is outside GENIUS payment-stablecoin scope: (1) it is a tracker certificate/security referencing an ETF, not a payment instrument designed for a fixed amount of monetary value (GENIUS Act §2(22)(B) excludes securities from the definition), and (2) Backed Assets (JE) Limited does not offer or sell to US persons. Issuer domicile is Jersey (Channel Islands); the Swiss DLT Act provides the structural framework for token issuance but does not change the Jersey corporate domicile.

mintAuthority.summary: bIB01 has independently mintable native transparent proxies on seven chains. Three chain-group Safe authorities can mint without an on-chain cap, while every chain-local token owner and ProxyAdmin owner resolves to the same separate zero-delay 2-of-3 EOA signer set.

controls.label: Backed Ethereum/Gnosis direct-minter Safe signer group
controls.capDescription: No on-chain mint cap; the configured minter may mint an arbitrary uint256 amount.
controls.evidence: At the pinned Ethereum and Gnosis blocks, token minter() returned chain-local 2-of-3 Safes 0xdd276f57e40d745e09855ba5711613f5da0c4a71 and 0xfe4c27e80e0e1cd11aabcc27432e684c73c832f3. Both had the same three EOA owners, no modules or guard, and zero delay. Verified BackedTokenImplementation mint() imposes no numeric cap.

controls.label: Backed deployment-wide token-owner / ProxyAdmin signer authority
controls.evidence: Across all seven pinned deployments, token owner() and ProxyAdmin.owner() resolved to chain-local 2-of-3 Safes with the same three EOA owners, no modules or guard, and zero delay. These owners can replace the configured direct minter and can immediately upgrade the shared transparent-proxy implementation. The failure-domain list preserves every distinct chain-local Safe address.

review.evidence: Pinned blocks were Ethereum 25526129, Gnosis 47187209, Base 48592766, Polygon 90179923, BSC 109812367, Arbitrum 483535601, and Avalanche 90233120. Every bIB01 deployment was a transparent proxy at the tracked address with implementation 0x28a0b491650fe761c8a66528422bc7ca24ecaeda, ProxyAdmin 0xf2057bdff8439dbffce073e14a9854945d5e5644, and zero beacon. Proxy, implementation, and ProxyAdmin runtime hashes were identical across all seven chains. Direct minters were chain-local 2-of-3 or 3-of-5 Safes, and every token-owner/ProxyAdmin-owner Safe instance resolved to the same separate 2-of-3 EOA signer set. Verified mint() has no cap; setMinter() and ProxyAdmin upgrades are immediate owner-only actions. Economic-control evidence reviewed 2026-07-15: The Network Firm obtains custody data directly and Chainlink refreshes Backed proof-of-reserve values every 24 hours or after a material deviation. The Jersey registration document expressly does not confer regulated status on Backed Assets (JE) Limited, so the recurring reconciliation has no qualifying prudential supervisor.
